## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] A changeset if users can notice this (`npx changeset`), written for the person upgrading
- [ ] If `api/surface.txt` changed: additions only, or the removal was deprecated in an earlier release
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`), if behaviour or options changed
